title: Verifying a signed token

concepts.description: Comparing secrets with a constant-time function stops an attacker learning how many leading bytes were right from response time.
concepts.context: verifyToken in verify.ts uses timingSafeEqual on the HMAC bytes instead of ===

concepts.description: Servers' clocks differ slightly, so expiry checks allow a small grace window rather than failing valid tokens at the edge.
concepts.context: verify.ts adds CLOCK_SKEW_SECONDS to claims.exp before comparing with now

concepts.description: timingSafeEqual throws on buffers of different lengths, so the lengths are compared first, which leaks only the length.
concepts.context: verify.ts rejects a signature of the wrong length before calling timingSafeEqual
